company_name: Dongguan Aozon New Material Technology Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides adhesive materials essential for semiconductor applications, which are critical in various stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Dongguan Aozon New Material Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the R&D, production, and sales of adhesives and new materials tailored for the semiconductor value chain. Their products are crucial for sectors such as optoelectronic displays and energy storage, supporting advanced semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.China: Main production base in Shaoguan with R&D centers and laboratories across multiple cities.
